narrative.intro: Federal contract obligations through FY2026 to date totaled $169B. Growth is concentrated in construction, manufacturing, and specialized services. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction led with 204.4% growth year over year, followed by Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at 139.1% and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at 114.4%. Other notable gains include Automobile Manufacturing at 98.6%, Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) at 73.2%, and Telecommunications Resellers at 61.7%. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing grew 54.2%, Software Publishers grew 44.8%, Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction grew 44.0%, and Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) grew 37.8%. These increases are measured year over year for the same fiscal period, and current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). The ranking lists markets by percentage change in contract obligations, highlighting where federal spending accelerated most compared with the same period last year.

sections.heading: Which industries posted the largest year-over-year gains?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction posted the largest gain at 204.4%. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 139.1%, and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 114.4%. Several manufacturing and services categories also showed strong increases, including Automobile Manufacturing at 98.6% and Telecommunications Resellers at 61.7%.

sections.heading: How should I interpret these growth figures for FY2026 to date?
sections.body: These figures are year-over-year percentage changes for the same fiscal period and reflect changes in contract obligations. Current-year totals are partial because they cover fiscal year to date. The ranking orders markets by the size of that percentage change, not by absolute dollar totals.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are the industries listed by percent growth: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction (204.4%), Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction (139.1%), Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services (114.4%), Automobile Manufacturing (98.6%), Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) (73.2%), Telecommunications Resellers (61.7%), Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing (54.2%), Software Publishers (44.8%), Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction (44.0%), and Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) (37.8%). These rankings show year-over-year percentage increases in contract obligations for FY2026 to date.

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Market growth here is measured as year-over-year percentage change in contract obligations for the same fiscal period. The figures compare current fiscal year to date obligations with obligations for the same period in the prior year. Current-year totals are partial because they cover fiscal year to date.
